subject: 🏃 Thursday — 6 mi Progression + C30 Fuel Rehearsal (Wk 2)
html:
Tomorrow: 6 mi progression run — Week 2 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation & Durability. 73 days to race day. This is a double-duty session: progression stimulus plus your first on-the-run test of Neversecond C30 before Sunday's Bay to Breakers.

The run: 4 mi @ 9:00 easy, then 2 mi at threshold (7:15–7:25). Do the standard 5-min pre-run activation first — quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks, glute bridges, plus PT-prescribed quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side). Final 0.5 mi is uphill home — switch from pace to HR: target 155–162 BPM on the Polar H10, hard cap 165. Let pace float; chasing 7:15 uphill turns threshold into VO2 and defeats the purpose.

C30 fuel rehearsal:

  • Pre-run (~30 min before): Small banana + 8 oz water with ½ scoop C30 drink mix (~30 g carb).
  • Mile 3.5 (just before threshold): 1 C30 gel (30 g carb) — stress-test the gut at threshold pace.
  • Post-run (within 30 min): 30+ g protein (eggs or Greek yogurt + berries).

Pay attention to how the gel goes down while breathing hard, stomach feel for 10–15 min after, and any flavor fatigue from the drink mix. If C30 sits clean, it's locked from here to July 26.

Context: You're in strong shape entering this session. Tuesday's 6×800m were textbook — every rep at or under target with a 6:40 finisher, HR peaked at 167 (controlled), and knee was 1/5. Yesterday's heavy strength was equally clean: all four exercises completed Rx, straps solved the grip issue on RDLs, knee 1/5 throughout. Three consecutive 1/5 readings across track, heavy compound lifts, and now a progression run — that's the durability signal we're building toward.

Focus cue: Cadence in the threshold block. You held 167 spm on Tuesday's intervals — lock that in again. On the uphill 0.5 mi, shorten the stride and let turnover carry you up. Don't lengthen and grind.

Knee veto: If you wake up at 2/5, drop the threshold portion and run the full 6 easy at 9:00. Still do the C30 rehearsal — the fuel test is independent of the pace stimulus.

Prep tonight: Lay out C30 gel, drink mix scoop, and bottle on the counter. Set the alarm for 5:15. Bed by 10. PT follow-up is Friday — bring her the week's data (track session, heavy strength, and this run).
